title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
abstract: arXiv:2610.39264v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While frontier vision-language models demonstrate strong capabilities in user interface (UI) navigation, their high inference costs prohibit everyday use. Conversely, smaller models trained via supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or offline reinforcement learning often memorize static trajectories, leading to brittle execution and an inability to recover from errors. To address these limitations, we propose a novel online reinforcement learning framework that trains UI navigation agents directly on live iOS applications. Our framework decouples the agent into two specialized components: a Planning agent and a UI Grounding model. We rely on an LLM-as-a-Judge to provide comprehensive reward signals, combining dense, step-level feedback to evaluate intermediate progress with a terminal reward for overall task completion. translated_title: 面向真实iOS应用UI导航的基于规划-定位智能体的在线密集强化学习
translated_abstract: 尽管前沿视觉语言模型在用户界面（UI）导航方面展现出强大的能力，但其高昂的推理成本阻碍了日常使用。相反，通过监督微调（SFT）或离线强化学习训练的较小模型往往只会记忆静态轨迹，导致执行脆弱且无法从错误中恢复。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了一种新颖的在线强化学习框架，可直接在真实的iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体。我们的框架将智能体解耦为两个专门的组件：规划智能体和UI定位模型。我们依靠LLM作为评判者来提供全面的奖励信号，将用于评估中间进度的密集、步骤级反馈与用于评估整体任务完成的终端奖励相结合。为了有效利用这种双重奖励结构，我们使用带有步骤级的近端策略优化（PPO）来优化智能体。
tldr: 提出了一种在线强化学习框架，将智能体解耦为规划智能体与UI定位模型，利用LLM作为评判者提供密集的步骤级奖励与终端奖励，并通过PPO直接在真实iOS应用上训练UI导航智能体，克服了现有模型成本高、易记忆静态轨迹且无法从错误中恢复的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an online reinforcement learning framework that decouples the agent into a planning agent and a UI grounding model, leveraging LLM-as-a-Judge for dense step-level and terminal rewards to train UI navigation agents via PPO directly on live iOS apps, overcoming high inference costs and brittle execution of existing approaches.
